description: This Kotlin source file defines a class `CloudSyncManager` responsible for synchronizing event and leave data between a local database and a Firebase Firestore cloud database within an Android application. It includes methods for merging data, resolving conflicts based on last modified timestamps, and updating both local and remote datasets accordingly.

classes.name: CloudSyncManager
classes.description: Manages synchronization of event and leave data between local storage and Firebase Firestore, handling conflict resolution and data merging.

methods.name: syncData
methods.description: Initiates synchronization of local and remote event and leave data, returning a Boolean indicating success or failure.

methods.name: mergeEvents
methods.description: Merges local and remote event data, updating local database and cloud storage accordingly, handling additions, updates, and deletions.

methods.name: mergeLeaves
methods.description: Merges local and remote leave data with similar logic as mergeEvents, managing data consistency between local and cloud storage.
